expectations.text: Fact retained: Rate limiter state is in Redis because there are three replicas and the limit must be shared
expectations.evidence: 'Redis holds one shared count' after 'ledgerd runs three replicas... A counter inside each process would give each replica its own count'.

expectations.text: Fact retained: Sticky sessions were rejected because partners don't send cookies
expectations.evidence: 'Sticky sessions (pinning a client to one replica) were rejected because partners don't send cookies.'

expectations.text: Fact retained: Rate-limited responses are 429 with Retry-After
expectations.evidence: 'over-limit requests get a 429 with a `Retry-After` header'.

expectations.text: Fact retained: 429 was chosen over 503 because the mobile client already backs off on 429
expectations.evidence: '503 was rejected because the mobile client already backs off on 429.'

expectations.text: Fact retained: Silently queueing requests was rejected because it hides the problem from partners
expectations.evidence: 'Silently queueing excess requests was rejected because it hides the problem from partners.'

expectations.text: Fact retained: The limit is keyed per API key, not per IP, because partners share egress IPs
expectations.evidence: 'Per API key, not per IP... Partners share egress IPs, so an IP-based limit would throttle different partners together.'

expectations.text: Fact retained: Balances must never be older than 30 seconds (cache TTL is load-bearing)
expectations.evidence: The 30-second balance-freshness invariant and load-bearing cache TTL are not mentioned anywhere in the response.

expectations.text: Fact retained: Per-tenant quotas are not decided; default is one limit for all partners
expectations.evidence: 'Per-partner quotas. Not decided. For now, all partners share one limit.'

expectations.text: Fact retained: Whether the mobile app gets its own higher limit is open
expectations.evidence: 'A separate mobile limit. Whether the mobile app gets its own, higher limit.' listed under 'Still open'.

expectations.text: Fact retained: A partner hit 2k rps last month and made the mobile app slow
expectations.evidence: 'Last month one partner hit ledgerd at 2k requests per second, and the app slowed down for everyone.'

expectations.text: Fact retained: The user prefers a picked default over a config knob
expectations.evidence: 'The owner's standing preference: pick a default rather than add a config knob, and revisit later.'

suggestions: Dropped the only invariant in NOTES.md (never return a balance older than 30s; cache TTL is load-bearing). An explanation of the notes should keep it, or at least flag that the limiter must not touch the cache TTL.
Minor embellishment: 'the app slowed down for everyone' adds 'for everyone', which the user quote does not say.
eval_feedback.overall: 10/11 facts retained, all with reasons. No factual errors. Extra claims (load balancer, stale docs/design.md, draft_reply.md leaning token bucket, algorithm and numbers unrecorded) check out against CLAUDE.md, docs/design.md and draft_reply.md. The only miss is the 30s invariant.
